title: General Manager
description:
Focused on strategic growth and operational excellence
Leveraging new technologies to accelerate growth and profitability
Demonstrated leadership capability - experience managing large, diverse teams
About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced General Manager to lead a stable, diversified business in Lae, PNG. This is a high-profile role overseeing multiple divisions within a diversified business spanning agriculture, wholesales and commercial ventures. The successful candidate will drive growth, capture new opportunities, and position the business for long-term value creation.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive business growth, including commercialising assets, exploring export opportunities.
Lead multiple divisions including agriculture, animal production, property and feed operations.
Manage sales, commercial operations, and strategic initiatives across all divisions.
Oversee a workforce of ~600 employees within a broader group of ~1,300, building capability and fostering a high-performance culture.
Support shareholder objectives, including strategic investments/divestments, partnerships and alignment with business priorities.
Provide strong operational leadership, including change management, process improvement, and risk management.
Engage with Boards, partners, regulators, investors and community stakeholders.
The Ideal Candidate:
Energetic, growth-oriented, and results-driven leader with demonstrated commercial acumen and a track record of delivering strong performance across multiple business units or divisions.
Proven experience in organisational change, transformation, and operational improvements.
10+ years’ experience in a General Manager or senior leadership role within agriculture, farming, wholesale, or related industries.
Experience in import/export, sales, and commercial operations.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage diverse teams and large, multi-division operations.
Strategic and hands-on leader able to identify and capitalise on new business opportunities and ensure their successful implementation.
Skilled in engaging Boards, investors, and key stakeholders while ensuring strong governance, financial oversight, and delivery of strategic objectives.
Why This Role:
Lead a high-profile, multi-division business with significant growth and commercial potential.
Opportunity to shape the strategic direction, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified organisation.
Work closely with senior leadership and Boards, influencing major business decisions and strategic initiatives.
Manage a substantial workforce, building capability and fostering a high-performance culture.
Exposure to a variety of industries, including agriculture, wholesale, and commercial ventures, offering a broad and dynamic leadership experience.
Competitive remuneration package reflecting the seniority and responsibilities of the role.
Open to Expatriates and PNG Nationals
